newsitem.title: USA: Neuromedical to buy Hong Kong's New System.
newsitem.headline: Neuromedical to buy Hong Kong's New System.

text.p: Neuromedical Systems Inc said on Monday that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire New System International Ltd, a Hong Kong corporation, adding dozens of Chinese hospitals and clinics as potential clients for its Papnet Testing System.

Neuromedical Systems also said it has agreed in principal to acquire the business of New System Taiwan Ltd, and that upon completion of both transactions the total purchase price for the acquisitions would come to roughly US$1.3 million plus future royalty payments of 3 to 4 percent of revenue from Hong Kong, China and Taiwan.

New System International was the operating subsidiary of Papnet Ltd, a distributor of Neuromedical's Papnet Testing System in Hong Kong and China. It had more than 40 hospitals and gynecology clinics as clients in China, Neuromedical said in a statement.

The Papnet test is approved for reimbursement at the rate of US$20 per patient by the Beijing government, whose reimbursement policies are typically followed by other Chinese cities, Neuromedical said.
Neuromedical Systems Inc is a healthcare technology company specializing in diagnostic screening applications to aid in the early detection of certain cancers.
